description: This file defines an abstract registry class for managing JSON parsable classes that are annotated and part of a class hierarchy. It uses class index annotations to dynamically locate classes and create parsing strategies.

classes.name: AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for collecting and managing JSON parsable classes based on annotations, supporting dynamic class discovery and strategy merging.

methods.name: mergeParsingStrategies
methods.description: Merges two maps of parsing strategies, with values in the second map overriding those in the first.

methods.name: initAnnotationBasedParseStrategies
methods.description: Initializes parsing strategies by scanning classes with the specified annotation that extend a base class, creating strategies via a factory.
